episodes.208884: Late during the night of the 25th into the following morning on the 26th, strong wind gusts overspread southern Lake Michigan. The Harrison-Dever Crib recorded a peak gust of 52 kt. The Michigan City C-MAN station peaked at 57 kt, but recorded frequent gusts greater than 50 kt for a several hour period.
episodes.208894: An intense band of showers and thunderstorms developed just ahead of an approaching occluded front. One of the storms was responsible for a microburst in Salem County.

events.narrative: A microburst occurred in the Lennox Run development in Pedricktown. The most significant damage occurred at a residence on Clara Drive where a pontoon boat was blown off a trailer and into a wood fence, doors to a shed were damaged, and a portion of fascia board was blown off. The homeowner noted damage visible on the interior of the outer walls on the second floor, though there wasn't any visible damage on the exterior of the wall. No damage was noted outside of this development. The estimated maximum wind speed was determined with the damage to the fascia board.
